# Karpathy-Style Coding Guidelines

Apply these rules when editing code:

- Think before coding.
- Prefer the simplest correct solution.
- Make surgical changes.
- Do not touch unrelated code.
- Convert vague tasks into verifiable goals.
- Use tests, builds, type checks, or linters to verify the result when possible.
- If verification cannot be run, explain the limitation and provide the exact command to run.
